messages.subject: Error in function: "funcGetAnalysisMethods"
parts:
Dear all,

I used MaAsLin in Galaxy and worked well. However, I'd like to try in R and use it through R. I installed all necessary packages.

Then I run these commands as shown in documentation of MaAsLin: 

InputTSV <- system.file('input.tsv', package="Maaslin")
InputConfig <-system.file('MaAsLin.read.config', package="Maaslin")
Maaslin(InputTSV,'maaslin_example_output',strInputConfig=InputConfig)

And as a results I got this error:

Error in Maaslin(InputTSV, "maaslin_example_output", strInputConfig = InputConfig) : 
  could not find function "funcGetAnalysisMethods"

I couldn't figure out the problem exactly. Can you please help to sort out the problem? By the way, input and config files are in attachment.

Thank you very much.

All the best,
Bahti
